metadata.title: Ether Predictive & Future Cliodynamic Projections Suite (2026-2100)
metadata.description: Standardized multi-metric predictive trajectories from international integrated assessment models and demographic agencies (UN WPP 2024, IPCC AR6 / IIASA SSP2, Club of Rome World3 recalibrated 2021).

sources.name: United Nations World Population Prospects (2024 Revision)
sources.agency: United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs (UN DESA), Population Division
sources.variant: Medium / Median Variant (with 95% Prediction Interval bounds)

sources.name: Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSP2: Middle of the Road)
sources.agency: IIASA / IPCC Working Group III (MESSAGEix-GLOBIOM & IMAGE Marker Models)
sources.variant: SSP2 Baseline & SSP2-4.5 Intermediate Radiative Forcing

sources.name: World3 Standard Run (Business-as-Usual / BAU2)
sources.authors: Meadows et al. (1972, 2004), Herrington (2021 update, Journal of Industrial Ecology)

worldPopulation_UN_WPP_Median.description: UN DESA 2024 Median Demographic Projection. Peaks around 2084 at ~10.29 billion.

grossWorldProduct_IPCC_SSP2.description: Global economic output under SSP2 Middle of the Road (MESSAGEix-GLOBIOM).

primaryEnergy_IPCC_SSP2.description: Total primary energy demand across all sources under SSP2.

co2Concentration_IPCC_SSP2_45.description: Atmospheric CO2 mixing ratio under SSP2-4.5 intermediate pathway (MAGICC7 climate model).

temperatureAnomaly_IPCC_SSP2_45.description: Global mean surface temperature anomaly under SSP2-4.5 intermediate forcing.

urbanizationRate_UN_DESA.description: Global proportion of urban population projected by UN World Urbanization Prospects.

worldPopulation_World3_BAU2.description: Limits to Growth World3 BAU2 trajectory (Herrington 2021). Overshoot and decline.
